heroHeadline: Outbreak Widens to 20 States as Georgia, Tennessee, Texas Added; Combined Season-Wide Count Tops 29,000
heroSubtitle: CDC's Aug 27 weekly update adds Georgia, Tennessee, and Texas to the Taylor Farms/Taco Bell multistate outbreak, pushing it to 20 states and 11,458 confirmed illnesses with 495 hospitalizations and 2 unchanged deaths in Michigan. Case growth continues at a slower pace than mid-August's peak. Separately, CDC's broader season-wide tally across all Cyclospora clusters reached 29,024 combined cases (17,180 lab-confirmed) across 48 states as of Aug 25, and North Carolina's distinct parsley/cilantro cluster grew to 940 cases and 32 hospitalizations as of Aug 26.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
